thread:
sahil: Quick question for the UX folks — when the automatic fallback policy kicks in (e.g., model X -> model X-small), what should the user-facing notifications look like? Should we treat fallback as an error, a warning, or a silent state?
elaine: My vote is warning by default. We shouldn't spam customers on transient fallbacks, but they should be able to opt into stricter alerts.
marc: Agree. Also need to call out quota/billing implications. If fallback increases token usage (eg. retries + extra tokens), customers might see a bill spike and get surprised.
lia: Can we distinguish notification types: immediate banner in console, daily digest email, and a billing alert channel?
sahil: Yes — thinking three tiers: 1) inline banner w/ reason & count, 2) console timeline entry (audit), 3) optional billing alert if cost delta > X%.
devin: Important: fallback sometimes happens because of quota throttling — should we surface "quota-induced fallback" separately from "error-induced fallback"? Different remediation paths.
marc: Definitely. Operationally they want a clear actionable item: "increase quota / reduce concurrency / pin model version".
lia: UX question: do we show the fallback decision trace inline (compact) or behind a "View details" flyout? Compact with expandable details to keep the banner small.
sahil: Prototype idea — banner shows: "Auto-fallback to X-small (5 occurrences in last 10m)." CTA: "View decision trace". In trace include: triggers, recent errors, routing policy that fired, and telemetry link.
elaine: Also add an opt-out: customers can mute notifications per-route for N hours. We already have a global mute toggle — per-route is useful.
marc: On the backend, we need a noise-suppression heuristic: suppress repeated identical banners for the same route for 30m unless severity increases.
ops-bot: Incident note: fallback policies triggered for customer `acme-corp` at 2025-03-12T14:22Z. Root cause: transient OOM on p3 pool -> auto-fallback to quantized model.
sahil: Example API snippet for customers who want programmatic alerts: \n```json\nPOST /v1/alerts/config\n{\n  "route": "acme/*",\n  "on_fallback": ["slack:#infra-alerts", "email:ops@acme.com"],\n  "suppress_for_minutes": 30,\n  "notify_on_cost_delta_pct": 10\n}\n```
lia: Nice. We should also expose the fallback "reason" enum: ["quota_throttle", "model_oom", "latency_sla", "explicit_rollout"]. Makes it easier to filter.
devin: For auditability, the console timeline must include a compact decision snapshot: policy id, trigger signal values, node ids, and model variant served. This needs to be immutable for 90 days.
marc: Agree on immutability. Also make the trace exportable as JSON for customers doing forensic analysis.
elaine: UX edge-case: if a route is pinned to a version, fallback should not silently override the pin without an explicit fallback-allow setting. Banner should say "pin honored; no auto-fallback" or "pin overridden by emergency-fallback".
sahil: Good call. We'll add a 3-state indicator: honored / attempted / overridden.
lia: On the console, add a small "noise level" indicator that shows how chatty the fallback alerts will be for that route (low/medium/high) based on recent behavior and suppression settings.
marc: Telemetry question: we need to capture the token delta pre/post fallback, and attribute cost to the fallback decision for billing analytics.
devin: Also tie regressions to eval prompt sets — if fallback increases hallucination or latency, we want automatic regression alerts to the model QA team.
sahil: Proposal for defaults: \n- UI: warning banner (dismissable for route)\n- Audit: decision trace + immutable timeline entry\n- Notifications: no billing alert unless cost delta > 15% or customer opts in\n- Suppression: 30m per-route dedupe, with escalation if frequency > 5/min\n- Pin behavior: require explicit override flag to replace pin
Anyone object?
elaine: Fine with defaults. Will prototype banner copy and flyout layout.
lia: I'll mock the noise-level indicator and per-route mute.
marc: I'll add telemetry events: `fallback_decision`, `fallback_cost_delta`, `fallback_pin_override`.
devin: I'll wire the API for programmatic alert config. Also adding a small CLI tool to pull decision traces.
deploy-bot: Rolling out `autofallback-notifications:v1` to staging at 3500000010...
ops-bot: Staging tests: simulated OOM -> fallback -> banner shows, trace link opens, suppression dedupe works.
sahil: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Elaine/lia to share mock screenshots by EOD Friday; Marc/Devin to sync on telemetry + API contract Monday.
marc: One more micro-proposal: include a "simulator" in the console where users can replay a recent decision trace and see what would have happened under a different suppression or cost threshold — helps with rollout experimentation.
elaine: Love that. Adds to UX for customers to tune noisiness without impacting live traffic.
sahil: Add to roadmap. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
